_comment: Nettskjema addresses for each form (for example https://nettskjema.no/a/123456). An empty address shows «Dette skjemaet er ikke klart ennå.» in the study. "round" is "pilot" or "study": in the pilot round the study forms come from "pilotForms", and every answer carries a version ending in -pilot; set "round" to "study" when the pilot is over. "studyPeriod" holds the first and last day of the study (YYYY-MM-DD); after the last day the welcome page says the study has ended. Edit this file only; no code change is needed.
